reports.what: Transpiling a BigQuery query that unnests a monthly GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY to Snowflake
reports.code: sqlglot.transpile("SELECT id, mnth FROM t CROSS JOIN UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(start_month, DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE, MONTH), INTERVAL '1' MONTH)) AS mnth", read="bigquery", write="snowflake")[0]
reports.got: "SELECT id, mnth FROM t CROSS JOIN TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(start_month, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE), INTERVAL '1 MONTH'))) AS _t0(seq, key, path, index, mnth, this)"
reports.want: "SELECT id, DATEADD(MONTH, CAST(mnth AS INT), CAST(start_month AS DATE)) AS mnth FROM t, LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => ARRAY_GENERATE_RANGE(0, DATEDIFF(MONTH, start_month, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE)) + 1)) AS _t0(seq, key, path, index, mnth, this)"

reports.what: Parsing a quoted BigQuery table name that includes INFORMATION_SCHEMA, the table's own name part
Transpiling a star next to another column to Exasol

reports.code: sqlglot.transpile("SELECT LAST_DAY(CAST('2008-11-25' AS DATE), MONTH)", read="bigquery", write="postgres")[0]
reports.got: "SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST('2008-11-25' AS DATE)) + (INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * 1) - (INTERVAL '1 DAY' * 1) AS DATE)"
reports.want: "SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST('2008-11-25' AS DATE)) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' - INTERVAL '1 DAY' AS DATE)"

reports.what: Round-tripping a DuckDB BIT_OR over a DECIMAL(10, 2)
reports.code: sqlglot.transpile("SELECT BIT_OR(CAST(val AS DECIMAL(10, 2))) FROM t", read="duckdb", write="duckdb")[0]
reports.got: 'SELECT BIT_OR(CAST(CAST(val AS DECIMAL(18, 3)) AS INT)) FROM t'
reports.want: 'SELECT BIT_OR(CAST(CAST(val AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS INT)) FROM t'

reports.what: Round-tripping an Exasol DATE_TRUNC on a timestamp literal
reports.code: sqlglot.transpile("SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MM', TIMESTAMP '2006-12-31T23:59:59') DATE_TRUNC", read="exasol", write="exasol")[0]

reports.what: Transpiling Snowflake TO_TIMESTAMP with a scale to BigQuery
Transpiling BigQuery DATETIME_DIFF in weeks to Presto
reports.code: sqlglot.transpile("SELECT DATETIME_DIFF(DATETIME '2017-10-15 00:00:00', DATETIME '2017-10-14 00:00:00', WEEK)", read="bigquery", write="presto")[0]
reports.got: "SELECT DATE_DIFF('WEEK', DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2017-10-14 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '-6' DAY), DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2017-10-15 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '-6' DAY))"
reports.want: "SELECT DATE_DIFF('WEEK', DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2017-10-14 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1' DAY), DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CAST('2017-10-15 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1' DAY))"
